item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 27/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, it will be cool and windy over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a rainband will bring showers and thunderstorms to the region. The weather over the coast of southern China will improve gradually midweek this week. Another relatively dry northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 27/03 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, northeast force 4 to 5 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cooler in the morning and at night. A few showers later.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
